status: proposed during preparation; frozen by the commit Astra reviews before granting

source.method: git archive of the bound commit into the evidence directory; every file checked against its git blob, the tree against this pin, and every one of the 2,879 freeze entries against its SHA-256

budgets.debit: Each attempt's frames and submissions are debited in a fsynced ledger row before launch, under the global native-gpu.lock and the packet lock; failed, interrupted and killed attempts stay charged.
budgets.existing_regression_frames: counted separately; not debited from the 24/48 budgets; one attempt per suite, no retry

builds.features: default only (physics-deterministic); cooked shader paths and persistent-pipeline-cache stay at their default-off settings
builds.note: tests-render keeps the brief's numeric-test package selection (-p incant_render alone). The review helper is copied into the child checkout only after tests-render and tests-host are frozen.

suite_count_derivation: 93 #[ignore] attributes in source minus persistent_cache.rs (crate-gated on feature persistent-pipeline-cache and test-gated on target_os linux) = 92 compiled on macOS default features, matching root's main200 count: 34 + 50 + 1 + 5 + 2.

numeric.submission_count_rule: 3 submitted frames, each counted twice (frame plus the renderer's completion-callback resolve); the actual count is 5
numeric.acceptance: exactly one test ran under its full compiled name (running 1, 1 passed, 0 ignored, its own 'test <name> ...' line), two samples with sequences 1 and 2, and every sample accepted by the measurement rule

measurement_acceptance: A sample counts only if its present groups equal the content-derived set (InitializeScene and Display always; Models with model draws; Shadows with model draws and a shadowing directional light; AssignLights with model draws and local lights; Sprites with sprites; Text with glyph quads), absent groups are absent, every present frame/group value is finite, every present endpoint is a nonzero counter, every span is ordered, the tick-to-nanosecond conversion matches the period, and the aggregate frame interval is positive. Equal nonzero endpoints are a valid quantized zero interval for one group. Typed errors (including Unwritten), all-zero payloads, skipped tests and missing samples are never accepted. Group ordering, containment and zero-length groups are observations only; durations are never read as performance.

review.rerun_rule: A second attempt of a case is allowed only after an infrastructure failure (timeout, a crash before report.json exists, or a debit without a result row) or when a committed entry in amendments names the case and the reason. It never hides a recorded failure: every attempt stays in the ledger and the result reports both. The global 24/48 caps still bind.
review.submission_count_rule: Each timing-enabled frame counts twice (frame plus the renderer's resolve submission); timing-disabled frames count zero.

probe.purpose: Adapter, backend, adapter/device timestamp feature flags and period for Renderer::new and Renderer::new_with_gpu_timing; the default constructor requests no timestamp feature and the timing constructor requests TIMESTAMP_QUERY; stats/take before any frame.

lit.purpose: Shadow look-dev geometry with a shadowing sun (four cascades), environment fill and two clustered point lights. Timing off: two frames on one device and one on a second device. Timing on: three measured frames fill the three slots with unread results, a fourth renders with instrumentation skipped, the consumer drains, and a fifth frame reuses a slot. All eight frames are compared byte for byte; four samples must be accepted measurements.

sprites_text.purpose: Pixel-perfect camera (100 px/unit, 320x180 logical, integer upscale) with three nearest-sampled sprites and world-space Latin/Arabic/CJK/.notdef text; no models, so Shadows/Models/AssignLights are absent.

viewport.purpose: The lit scene inside a fractional, offset, rounded editor-style viewport over a canvas color.

cascades.purpose: Four-cascade shadow group in isolation (sun shadows, no local lights): the first cascade pass writes the group beginning, the last its end, the two interior passes carry no descriptor. Timing off/on compare exact bytes and the timing-on sample must have both Shadows endpoints written. A timing-on control with the sun's shadows removed must render differently and report no Shadows group.

owner_drop.grant_approval: run only if review-ready.json lists "owner_drop" in approved_extra_cases
owner_drop.purpose: Bounded no-panic/no-hang lifecycle smoke only: submit one measured 64x64 frame (numeric-test fixture, non-readable target), drop the owning Renderer, wait on a retained device clone for that submission and then for all work including the renderer's resolve, then a fresh timing renderer starts empty. queue.submit may deliver the callback before drop(renderer), so callback-after-drop ordering is not established.

totals.counting: Every rendered review frame counts once as an appearance frame, including controls and frames whose PNG is not retained. Pixel readback copies are part of their frame's observation, not extra frames.

order: gpu.py review probe|lit|sprites_text|viewport|cascades [owner_drop only if approved]
analyze.py check (CPU only) and personal inspection of every retained frame
build.py lint (optional, CPU only, still under the lease)
